LESSON: SIGN READING 2.2.1 BOOK HANDLING.

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.2: Sign Reading 2.2.1 Book handling.
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 2.2.1 Book handling., part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we hold our books when reading? 2. How do we take care of our books?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 2.2.1 Book handling. together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: Flexibility as learner learns different ways of covering and caring for books.

● Learning to learn: Self discipline as learner discovers ways of caring for books.

Values:
● Unity: Equality as learner role plays covering their books in groups while arranging books.

● Responsibility: Accountability as learner learns to take care of own books.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Social cohesion as learner works with others amicably in groups.

Link to other Activity Areas :

Learner relates book handling skills to identification of different ways of handling the bible as a holy book used by

Christians to nature sense of responsibility in Religious activities.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Signed video clips, books, Flash cards, video games, charts, pictures, relevant digital devices.
